recipe.visualDefinition: A studio portrait of a five-member male vocal group in formal attire, emerging from a dense blue-purple mist against a vibrant magenta-to-violet gradient background, topped with layered geometric and script typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The subjects' black tuxedos provide high contrast against the saturated magenta background.
The low-lying blue fog anchors the composition and masks the lower bodies of the subjects.
The dual-layered typography at the top balances the weight of the group below.
coreInvariants: Formal black tuxedos with pink/magenta satin vests
Blue atmospheric fog at the base

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five men arranged in a tight, overlapping cluster, centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the pink vest acts as the focal point, framed by the other members.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down the faces of the group, and settle into the blue mist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space at the top for typography and at the bottom for atmospheric effects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and vests, with deep blacks providing structural definition.

letterConstructionRules: Display text is wide-set, thin-stroke geometric caps.
Subtitle text is a fluid, connected formal script with long flourishes.
A thin horizontal rule separates the two styles.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended crossbars and wide tracking for the sans-serif caps.
Exaggerated descenders and ascenders on the script 'I' and 'g'.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, wide-tracked geometric caps and fluid, organic script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line
Connected script for the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-set aesthetic of the top line.
Captures the elegant, flourished script style of the second line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of five men in black tuxedos with pink satin vests, arranged in a pyramid cluster. The background is a vibrant magenta-to-purple gradient. A thick layer of cyan-blue fog covers their legs and the bottom of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a line of wide-tracked, thin geometric sans-serif caps at the top. Below it, add a thin horizontal line. Under the line, add a line of white formal script with elegant flourishes, centered.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated magenta gradient?
Is there a clear blue fog at the bottom?
Are the men wearing black tuxedos with pink vests?
Is the top text wide-tracked and the bottom text script?

adjustableVariables: Number of subjects in the ensemble
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original group
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between black suits and magenta background.
Ensure the fog looks atmospheric and not like solid blocks.
Verify the script text is legible against the background.
Confirm the wide tracking of the top text is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Ensemble + Magenta Gradient + Blue Fog Base + Geometric/Script Typographic Stack
